name: cli-chat
description: Terminal chat and file sharing client supporting Syncplay and CFAT Edge Worker (api.cfat.site)

scripts.build:dev: npm run prebuild && npm run build:dev:win && npm run build:dev:linux
scripts.build:client: npm run prebuild && npm run build:client:win && npm run build:client:linux
scripts.build:glu: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');if(!fs.existsSync('build'))fs.mkdirSync('build');if(!fs.existsSync('build/dev.exe')){console.log('Building dev.exe prerequisite...');cp.execSync('npm run build:dev:win',{stdio:'inherit'});}if(process.platform==='win32'){cp.execSync('windres glu.rc -O coff -o build/glu_res.o && g++ -O2 -mwindows -static -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ glu.cpp build/glu_res.o -o build/glu.exe -lcomctl32 -lshell32 -lole32 -lcomdlg32',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{console.log('Skipping glu build on non-Windows')}"
scripts.build:win: npm run build:client:win && npm run build:dev:win && npm run build:glu
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:client:linux && npm run build:dev:linux
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && npm run build:dev && npm run build:client && npm run build:glu
